results.name: Klarner’s constant λ (polyomino growth)
results.scope: Exponential growth constant of all finite square-lattice polyominoes; the recurrence covers all sizes.
results.verification: All 1,186 pattern types, 10,539 terms and 22,334 decomposition steps checked, together with an exact rational supersolution.

sources.title: A convolutional approach to bounding the number of polyominoes
